$comment: Configuration for scripts/check-licenses.mjs (npm run check:licenses). Production dependencies end up in the deployed app and must match 'allowed' or have an exception. Development dependencies are never shipped and only produce warnings. Every exception needs a reason.

rgbcolor@1.0.1.reason: package.json declares the non-SPDX expression "MIT OR SEE LICENSE IN FEEL-FREE.md", so the checker can only guess ("MIT*"). LICENSE.md in the package is the MIT license text. Pulled in by jspdf -> canvg (optional dependency of jsPDF).
